notice: Gold labels for the topic tagger. Labelled by an AI reviewer (Claude) reading each question against the taxonomy tree and, where noted, searching the textbook text -- NOT by a teacher. A teacher's review may overturn individual labels.
sample: Two batches drawn the same way, 164 items each. Per class 6-10, Mathematics and Science: 11 NCERT Exemplar + 3 CBE items; Social Science class 10: 24 board-paper items (the only Social Science questions in any bank). Batch 1: random.Random(703).sample over each bank's records sorted by id; batch 2: random.Random(7032), same pools less batch 1. Batch 2 was drawn after batch 1 showed the topic and subtopic estimates rested on too few items.
semantics: chapters: the tree chapters of the question's own class that teach it; empty = no chapter of that class's book does (or the stem is unreadable). topics / subtopics: every node a reviewer would accept; empty = none fits, so any tag at that level is wrong.
